bondPriority.description: Increases Spirit Mastery by 8% and Crit rate by 10% during battle. When equipped by a Full Assault character, these effects are further increased by 100%.
bondPriority.name: Ulquiorra Bond

boundaries.description:
While in Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa, releasing the first Ultimate, Annihilation, does not consume Ultimate Energy or end Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa. In addition, the character immediately enters Thunderous Assault and restores Spiritual Pressure to maximum, allowing a second Ultimate, Annihilation, to be released after 5 second(s). 
 Reduces the cooldown of the Ultimate, Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa, by 5 second(s).
boundaries.name: Wings That Seal the Night

boundaries.description:
Enhanced Techniques, Cero Oscuras and Lanza del Relampago II, ignore 100% of the target's DEF. 
 While in Thunderous Assault, Lanza del Relampago I releases 50% faster and consumes 50% less Spiritual Pressure.
boundaries.name: Only Human Standards

boundaries.description: Releasing any type of Cero increases the character's ATK by 5%. Releasing any Lanza del Relampago reduces the target's Spirit Resistance by 2.5%. Both effects last 30 seconds and stack up to 4 times.
boundaries.name: A Meaningless Existence

boundaries.description:
Releasing any type of Cero or Lanza del Relampago causes Reishi Rain to fall on the field. This effect has a 5-second cooldown. Reishi Rain applies Void to the target for 8 seconds. When any character lands a critical hit on an enemy affected by Void, they immediately deal an extra attack equal to 10% of that attack's damage. When Ulquiorra triggers this effect, he deals damage equal to 20%. 
 Increases the damage of Reishi Rain by 66%.
boundaries.name: Hearts Bring Death

While in Resurreccion I, releasing a counter or the 4th hit of basic attack refreshes the technique cooldown. 
 
 When HP falls below 50%, Ulquiorra activates his instant regeneration, restoring 5% of his Max HP every second for 10 seconds. This effect has a 30-second cooldown.

name: Ulquiorra Shifar (Resurrección)
tips: Depending on boss RNG and other factors, you may be forced to skip some Technique spams during Segunda Etapa. This should only affect your Ult DMG the first time Annihilation is used.

rotations.name: Standard Opener
rotations.notes: Ulquiorra Basic Attacks refresh Technique cooldown once completed
steps: Support Counter → Ulquiorra Counter → Technique → Basic Attack → Technique → Special Attack → Cero Oscuras → Ultimate

skills.description:
Ulquiorra swings a light blade condensed from Reishi, dealing 4 hits of damage totaling 457.5% of ATK. ~~Gaze Upon Despair~~ Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa 
 Ulquiorra swings a light spear condensed from Reishi, dealing 6 hits of damage totaling 1085% of ATK, with the 3rd hit firing a Cero Oscuras. ~~Worlds Apart~~ At Max Spiritual Pressure, tap and hold basic attack 
 Ulquiorra soars into the air, then dives rapidly towards the target's location and attacks, dealing damage equal to 3345% of ATK and gaining 1 Cero Mark.
skills.name: Enclose, Murcielago

skills.description:
Ulquiorra fires a powerful Cero unique to the Espada from his fingertip, dealing damage equal to 600% of ATK and gaining 1 Cero Mark. ~~Cero Oscuras~~ Own 4 Cero Marks 
 Ulquiorra consumes 4 Cero Marks and releases a devastating Cero Oscuras, dealing damage equal to 810% of ATK to enemies. ~~Lanza del Relampago I~~ Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa 
 Ulquiorra consumes a certain amount of Spiritual Pressure to release Lanza del Relampago I, dealing damage equal to 270% of ATK and gaining 1 Thunder Mark. ~~Lanza del Relampago II~~ Own 4 Thunder Marks 
 Ulquiorra consumes all Thunder Marks to release the more powerful Lanza del Relampago II, dealing damage equal to 2242.5% of ATK and entering Thunderous Assault. Both types of Lanza del Relampago consumes a certain amount of Spiritual Pressure when released. 
 While in Thunderous Assault, tap the Technique button repeatedly to throw Lanza del Relampago I in rapid succession, but Thunder Marks cannot be gained during this time.
skills.name: Gran Rey Cero

skills.description:
Ulquiorra performs his second release, entering Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa, a form even Aizen has never seen. His Movement Speed and interruption resistance are greatly increased, and he gains a new set of attacks. 
 When this skill is released, Ulquiorra's Spiritual Pressure immediately increases to maximum, and his surging Spiritual Power causes Reishi Rain to fall across the battlefield, dealing damage equal to 900% of ATK to all enemies on the field every 0.5 seconds. ~~Annihilation~~ During Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa, release it again at Max Ultimate Energy 
 Ulquiorra gathers immense Spiritual Pressure into his weapon, then hurls the powerful Lanza del Relampago III at enemies, dealing damage equal to 3612.5% of ATK and ending Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa. At the same time, Reishi Rain falls on the battlefield, dealing damage equal to 900% of ATK to all enemies every 0.5 seconds.
skills.name: Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa

skills.description:
After countering an enemy attack, Ulquiorra instantly launches several counterattacks, then descends from the air with a powerful slash, dealing total damage equal to 1000% of ATK. ~~Crushed Will~~ Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa 
 Ulquiorra seizes and opening in the enemy's attack, counterattacks mercilessly, and knocks them back, dealing damage equal to 1600% of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
Use Sonido to avoid attacks right before they hit. 
 Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Ulquiorra gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Sonido

ascend5: Increases ATK by 50%, and Crit Rate is further increased by 15% while in Resurreccion: Segunda Etapa.
Each time the character releases any technique, Technique DMG increases by 10% for 20 seconds, stacking up to 8 times. At 8 stacks, Ultimate DMG is also increased by 50%.
The Enhanced Technique, Lanza del Relampago II, applies a Weakness Mark to the enemy, increasing all subsequent Lanza del Relampago DMG they take by 60% fo 15 seconds.
When any attack triggers a critical hit, an additional attack is triggered immediately, dealing damage equal to 25% of the attack's damage.
After Ulquiorra releases any Ultimate, his Crit DMG increases by 100% for 20 seconds.
At the start of battle, every extra 1% Ultimate Charge Rate increases his Crit Rate by 0.8%, up to a maximum of 55%.

rationale: Ulquiorra Shifar (Resurrección) is S tier as he is the strongest Spirit Full Assault currently in game. Toshiro unfortunately has trouble doing half of Ulquiorra's damage.

Ulquiorra's damage seems to be divided evenly between his Ultimate, Weapon Stamp, B6, and Techniques. His Reishi Rain counts as Ult DMG. Ulquiorra's own stamp set — Fill the Nothingness — is suggested, though Kenpachi's stamp set, Ready to Go, will also work (to a lesser extent). All DMG (Enhanced DMG/Overdrive) passives are highly recommended, followed by Ultimate DMG then Technique.
